credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/oak.py. Reference photo oak/baby.jpg by Steve Hurst, USDA-NRCS PLANTS Database (Public Domain (US government work)), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Quercus_alba_acorn.jpg: used as a drawing reference, not traced. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Intro: the cap tips up about its back hinge, a peek from under the brim (the dark cup interior shows), cranes a little higher, then SNAPS down 1px past rest with the brim flared. Only the cap and stalk move. Learned: the glossy cap shine and the nut specular are where Crystal's shared white earns its keep; the pale radicle feet are genuinely white tissue, so they take index 3 too. Sport: 'Concordia' golden oak. Quercus robur 'Concordia' (Van Geert, Ghent, 1843): butter-yellow leaves, gold-green acorns (indexes 1-2 only).
